title: The Pruning Shears
description: Trimming an overgrown garden teaches a woman how to cut back commitments that no longer serve her.
character_reference: a woman in her late twenties with short dark pixie-cut hair, wearing a forest green canvas work jacket, canvas utility trousers, and leather gardening gloves

scenes.narration: My backyard rosebushes had grown so wild they were blocking the sunlight from reaching the vegetable patch underneath.
scenes.visual: Medium shot of overgrown tangled rose branches blocking sunlight in a lush backyard garden, warm afternoon light filtering through leaves

scenes.narration: I had spent months watering every single stem, afraid that cutting anything back would mean killing the plant.
scenes.visual: Close-up of gloved hands holding a green garden hose spraying a fine mist over thick green foliage, soft natural lighting

scenes.narration: The nursery worker told me the hard truth: sometimes you have to prune away healthy growth so the core can survive.
scenes.visual: Medium shot standing in a garden holding metal pruning shears downward, thoughtful expression, warm outdoor lighting

scenes.narration: With a sharp snap of the steel shears, I cut away thick, thorny branches that had crowded the center for years.
scenes.visual: Close-up of pruning shears snapping cleanly through a thick woody stem, falling green leaves caught in motion blur

scenes.narration: At first, the bush looked bare and exposed, stripped down to its woody skeleton against the garden soil.
scenes.visual: Medium shot of a heavily pruned rosebush showing bare brown stems against dark damp garden mulch, bright daylight

scenes.narration: A week later, fresh green shoots erupted from the cuts, drinking in the unfiltered sun I had finally given them.
scenes.visual: Macro close-up of tiny bright green leaf buds emerging from a thick pruned branch tip, vibrant morning sunlight

scenes.narration: Saying no to good things is often the only way to make room for the great things meant for you.
scenes.visual: Medium shot resting hands on hips, smiling proudly at a healthy, well-spaced garden bed under warm afternoon sun

scenes.narration: Follow along for more reflections on clearing out the clutter to let your true life bloom.
scenes.visual: Close-up smiling warmly toward the camera in a sun-dappled backyard garden surrounded by green foliage
